paragraphs.en: In his tale, Demon recounted how he and his brothers inherited three thousand dinars from their father upon his death. Each brother used this inheritance to start a shop. After a year, his older brother sold his goods for a thousand dinars, bought trading supplies, and left on a trip.
paragraphs.zh: 在故事中，恶魔讲述了他和他的兄弟们在他父亲去世后继承了三千第纳尔。每个兄弟都用这笔遗产开起了店铺。一年之后，他的大哥卖掉了货物，得了千第纳尔，又买了些交易用品，便踏上了旅程。

paragraphs.en: One day, while Demon was in his shop, a beggar approached him. The man tearfully asked if he recognized someone. Upon closer inspection, Demon realized it was his brother.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，恶魔正在他的店铺里，一个乞丐走过来问他是否认识一个人。那人含泪问道，结果仔细一看，恶魔发现这个人竟是自己的兄弟。

paragraphs.en: He embraced him and brought him inside the shop. His brother explained that he had lost all his money and was in dire straits.
paragraphs.zh: 他一把抱进了店里，他的兄弟解释说已经输光了所有钱财，处境十分困顿。

paragraphs.en: Demon took his brother to the public bath, clothed him in one of his robes, and invited him home. After checking his accounts, Demon found he had made a thousand dinars, bringing his net worth to two thousand. He divided this sum equally between himself and his brother, advising him to act as if he had never left.
paragraphs.zh: 恶魔带他的兄弟去了公共浴室，给他穿上了自己的袍子，邀请他回家。检查完账目后，恶魔发现自己赚了一千第纳尔，净资产达到了两千第纳尔。他将这笔钱平分给了自己和兄弟，并建议兄弟装作从未离开过。

paragraphs.en: His brother gratefully accepted the money and opened another shop.
paragraphs.zh: 他的哥哥感激地收下了这笔钱，并开设了另一家店铺。

paragraphs.en: After selling his goods and collecting his money, my second brother embarked on a year-long trading trip despite our warnings. Upon returning, he was destitute, having lost all his possessions.
paragraphs.zh: 在卖完货物并收齐了钱之后，二哥不顾我们的劝阻，踏上了一年的商旅之旅。回来时，他已是身无分文，所有的财物都已荡然无存。

paragraphs.en: I took him to the public bath, dressed him in one of my new robes, and brought him back to the shop. After we had eaten, I said, "Brother, let's settle accounts for this year. Subtracting the capital, whatever profit there is, will be split equally."
paragraphs.zh: 我把这位老人带到公共浴室，给他穿上了我新做的袍子，然后送他回了店铺。吃过饭后，我说：“兄弟，咱们今年的账算一算吧。减去本金之后，剩下的盈利我们对半分。”

paragraphs.en: Upon examining my books, I found a two-thousand-dinar profit, which I divided into one thousand dinars each.
paragraphs.zh: 经过一番检查，我发现账面上多了两千第纳尔的利润，便将其均分成了两份各一千第纳尔。

paragraphs.en: With his share, he opened another shop, and we stayed together for some time. Then, my brothers invited me to join them on a trading journey, but I declined, saying, "What did you gain that I can't?"
paragraphs.zh: 有了自己的份额后，他开了一家新的店铺，我们一同度过了好一段时间。随后，我的兄弟们邀请我加入他们的贸易之旅，但我婉拒了，反问道：“你们得到了什么，我就不能有？”

paragraphs.en: After six years in our stores, my brothers continued to ask me to join them on trading journeys. I finally agreed but learned they had squandered all their money. Without reproach, I took stock and sold everything, netting six thousand dinars.
paragraphs.zh: 六年下来，哥哥们仍然邀请我一同外出贸易。终于，在他们的再三请求下，我答应了，却不料他们早已把家底花光。我没有责怪他们，而是自行盘点了库存，并将所有货物卖了个精光，最终净赚六千第纳尔。

paragraphs.en: Dividing it into two parts, I gave three thousand to my brothers for the journey and buried the other three thousand as a contingency plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我把这笔钱分成两部分，给了兄弟们三千作为旅途费用，并将剩下的三千埋起来以备不时之需。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Dinarzad urged Shahrazad to continue her story. The king requested that she complete the tale of the merchant and the demon. With pleasure, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，迪纳兹催促沙赫拉兹阿德继续讲故事。国王要求她讲完商人的故事和恶魔的故事。沙赫拉兹阿德欣然开始：

paragraphs.en: I heard, O happy King, that the second old man said to the demon:
paragraphs.zh: 我听见啊，幸福的国王，那第二位老人对妖魔说道：

paragraphs.en: For a month, my brothers and I sailed across the sea, selling our goods in a port city and doubling our wealth. After purchasing more items, we prepared to leave when I met a girl dressed in rags. She begged me, "O my lord, be kind and marry me.
paragraphs.zh: 一个月来，我和兄弟们乘船航行到一个港口城市贩卖货物，赚得盆满钵满。当我们准备再次启程时，我遇到了一个衣衫褴褛的女孩。她乞求道：“我的老爷，请您施舍一下，娶我为妻。”

paragraphs.en: I will reward you for your generosity." Moved by her plea, I agreed, clothed her, and married her on the boat.
paragraphs.zh: 我被她的恳求打动，答应了她，并为她披上衣物，随后在船上与她结为夫妇。

paragraphs.en: We sailed together for many days, but soon my brothers grew jealous of my increasing wealth and possessions. They envied my good fortune and plotted to betray me. One night, while I slept beside my wife, they threw us both into the sea, driven by their envy and the Devil's temptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们一同航行了多日，但很快我的兄弟们对我日益增多的财富和 possessions 感到了嫉妒。他们羡慕我的好运，密谋背叛我。一天夜里，当我与妻子同眠时，他们竟将我和她一起抛入海中，被他们的嫉妒和魔鬼的引诱所驱使。

paragraphs.en: Upon awakening, my wife transformed into a she-demon and carried me to an island. In the morning, she revealed her intention to kill my brothers. Despite being amazed and grateful, I refused to harm them.
paragraphs.zh: 醒来后，妻子化作一只雌妖，将我带到了一个岛上。清晨时分，她透露了要杀害我兄弟们的意图。尽管我感到惊讶并心存感激，还是坚决拒绝伤害他们。

paragraphs.en: I recounted our shared experiences, which angered her but also made her determined to drown their boat. I pleaded with her, citing a proverb about kindness towards those who hurt us. Eventually, she agreed not to proceed.
paragraphs.zh: 我讲述了我们共同的经历，这让她愤怒不已，但也激发了她要把船沉下去的决心。我引用了一句关于宽恕伤害我们的人的谚语来求情，最终她同意不再继续这个计划。

paragraphs.en: Returning home, I retrieved the buried money and reopened my shop in the market. That evening, two dogs tied up greeted me, weeping and rubbing against me. My wife then revealed that they were indeed my brothers, transformed by her sister's magic for ten years.
paragraphs.zh: 回到家，我取出了埋藏的财宝，并重新在市场开张。那天晚上，两条被拴着的狗迎面而来，一边呜咽一边蹭着我的腿。妻子随后透露，它们确实是我失散多年的兄弟，因姐姐施展魔法而化为狗已有十年之久。

paragraphs.en: The spell would be lifted after this period.
paragraphs.zh: 这段咒语将在一段时间后解除。

paragraphs.en: On our way to lift the curse, I met a man and an old deer-man. After learning of his encounter with you, I decided not to leave until knowing what transpired between him and you. This is my tale, indeed strange and wondrous.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们前往解除诅咒的路上，我遇到了一个人和一只老鹿人。得知他与你的遭遇后，我决定不离开，直到了解他与你之间的故事。这就是我的故事，确实奇异而神奇。

paragraphs.en: The she-demon responded, "By God, it is strange and amazing. I grant you one-third of my claim on him for his crime."
paragraphs.zh: 女妖回答说：“天哪，真是奇怪而令人惊叹。我愿意将他应得的三分之一份额交给你作为赔偿。”

paragraphs.en: The third old man challenged the demon: "If I tell you a stranger and more amazing tale than the first two, will you give me one-third of your claim on him?" The demon agreed. Shahrazad then recounted how the demon was amazed by the story and granted the old man his request, freeing the merchant.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个老人向恶魔挑战道：“如果你听我讲一个比前两个更离奇的故事，你是否愿意将那个商人的三分之一归我所有？”恶魔答应了。沙赫拉兹阿德接着讲述，说恶魔听了这个故事后大为惊讶，并满足了老人的要求，释放了那位商人。

paragraphs.en: The three old men congratulated the merchant before parting ways. He returned home to his family and lived happily until his death.
paragraphs.zh: 三位老人与商人大概寒暄了几句便各自离去。商人回到家中，与家人幸福地生活在一起，直到终老。

paragraphs.en: Dinarzad asked for more, and Shahrazad promised a tale even stranger than this one—the story of the fisherman.
paragraphs.zh: 丁纳扎德还想听更多，沙赫拉兹德答应给他讲一个比这个还要离奇的故事——渔夫的故事。
